# Churnly

> Churnly is churn-risk analysis software for SaaS businesses, agencies, and other subscription-based companies. It detects customers likely to cancel and drafts the retention email/action ready to send, based on a company's own Stripe or CSV customer data.

## What it does

- Imports customer data via a read-only Stripe connection or a CSV upload.
- Scores each customer's churn risk with an AI model (Anthropic Claude), based on payment status, renewal date, usage/support signals.
- Generates a ready-to-send retention email/offer for each at-risk customer.
- Pricing is based on the customer's declared monthly revenue (continuous scale, capped at 2,500€/month), or a percentage of measured recovered revenue under the performance-billing plan (50€ base + 20% of proven recovery, measured via a control group).
